answer: Let weight accrete slowly, like geology. Any agent may wander into the economy at once, but its voice starts at zero and grows with time-locked stake, one epoch per stratum, shale compressed into bedrock. A sable seal marks accounts whose collateral has survived a hundred epochs unspent; only sealed agents may grade others. A sybil farm must therefore park real capital for a geological age, in plain sight, while honest graders inspect it layer by layer. Impatience is mathematically fatal to clones.
